title: The Third Root of Tel Naga

hook.rumour: At the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora, Mouths and Imperial clerks alike complain that rogue spore-anchor experiments are warping the fungal sea-lanes between Wolverine Hall, Firewatch, and Port Telvannis.
hook.notice: NOTICE OF THE COUNCIL AT TEL NAGA — Competent outlanders or retainers hired to investigate the unstable root-conduits between Sadrith Mora, Firewatch, and Port Telvannis.
hook.context: In Telvannis, a wizard's argument is settled by survival: if an experiment succeeds, it is lawful; if it threatens the Council's trade lanes, someone is hired to prune it.

stages.objective: Take the commission from the Council Mouths at Tel Naga and the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora
Compare the Mages Guild aetheric readings inside Wolverine Hall
Inspect the scorched fungal root-graft at Tel Rendys

objectives.text: Take the commission from the Council Mouths at Tel Naga and the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora
Compare the Mages Guild aetheric readings inside Wolverine Hall
Inspect the scorched fungal root-graft at Tel Rendys

consequence_detail.summary: Readings from Wolverine Hall and Tel Rendys prove someone is splicing Dwemer resonators into living Emperor Parasol roots across the archipelago.

stages.objective: Question the Imperial charter-inspectors in Firewatch about the stolen Dwemer coils
Check the magisterial factor-ledgers on the mushroom docks of Port Telvannis
Seize the smuggling manifest from the storage vaults at Voryn Plantation

objectives.text: Question the Imperial charter-inspectors in Firewatch about the stolen Dwemer coils
Check the magisterial factor-ledgers on the mushroom docks of Port Telvannis
Seize the smuggling manifest from the storage vaults at Voryn Plantation

consequence_detail.summary: The manifest seized near Port Telvannis reveals a rogue magisterial apprentice has turned Tel Dreloth into a living spore-furnace.

stages.objective: Secure a boat-passage and ward-salts from the Indoril factors at Gorne
Clear the mutated spore-thralls inside Tel Dreloth and dismantle the Dwemer root-core
Purge the secondary spore-vent inside Ikhuraarnit Egg Mine

objectives.text: Secure a boat-passage and ward-salts from the Indoril factors at Gorne
Clear the mutated spore-thralls inside Tel Dreloth and dismantle the Dwemer root-core
Purge the secondary spore-vent inside Ikhuraarnit Egg Mine

consequence_detail.summary: The rogue root-core in Tel Dreloth is dismantled before its spores can choke the Zafirbel Bay shipping channels.

stages.objective: Present the dismantled Dwemer root-core to the Council Mouths inside Tel Naga
Deliver the stabilized aetheric readings to the Imperial liaison at Sadrith Mora
Claim your Magisterial Precedent Writ at the Gateway Plaza in Sadrith Mora

objectives.text: Present the dismantled Dwemer root-core to the Council Mouths inside Tel Naga
Deliver the stabilized aetheric readings to the Imperial liaison at Sadrith Mora
Claim your Magisterial Precedent Writ at the Gateway Plaza in Sadrith Mora

consequence_detail.summary: Since you survived and dismantled the rogue tower, the Council of Tel Naga declares your action lawful precedent and awards you a Magisterial Writ.
